rule: MEASURED at the base x 1.10, rounded up; +8 rows under 80 rows. Ratchet only: a raise needs "raised": { from, reason }.

reasons.static-or-document: served assets or documents; no D1 read
reasons.write-not-measured: a write route with no measured shape yet; the slice that changes it adds one
reasons.get-not-in-shapes: a GET with no shape yet: OAuth callback, job poll, download, duplicate check
